items.title: Guided Layman Recommendation Engine (MYR + USD Auto-Split)
items.notes: Plain-English planner translating RM budget, timeline, emergency savings, and dip comfort into exact Versa (MYR) + US ETF (USD) allocations.

items.title: Non-Individual Stock Universe (Versa Portfolios + Broad US ETFs)
items.notes: Includes 9 Versa funds and 9 broad US ETFs (VOO, VTI, VT, QQQM, SCHD, SGOV, SPUS, HLAL, SPSK) with zero single-stock picking risk.

items.title: All Funds + Instant Shariah-Only (-i / Halal) Toggle
items.notes: Global one-click toggle switches recommendations and explorer seamlessly between full universe and 100% Shariah-compliant options.

items.title: Market-Driven Self-Improving Calibration + GitHub Actions
items.notes: Scheduled GitHub Action (.github/workflows/self-improve.yml) and in-app calibration engine evaluate market returns/drawdowns, adjust scoring weights safely, update handoff.md, and commit to Git.

items.title: Automatic handoff.md Reference & Continuous Git Sync
items.notes: All architecture, active plan summaries, fund metrics, calibration logs, and open requirements stay updated in handoff.md and synced to Git.

items.title: Actual Holdings Tracker & Monthly Rebalancing Alert
items.notes: Allow logging actual units/RM invested each month in Versa & US broker to show drift vs target % and suggest exact next payday top-up.

items.title: Broker & FX Cost Comparison Helper (IBKR / Moomoo MY / Rakuten / FSMOne)
items.notes: Help beginners pick the cheapest MY-regulated or international broker based on monthly DCA size (e.g. RM300/mo vs RM2,000/mo).

items.title: EPF / ASB / PRS Integration Toggle
items.notes: Account for existing EPF or ASB balances as part of the investor's safe Ringgit base so US ETF / Versa Growth weights adjust holistically.
